rows.grounds: indeclinable adverb; L1/L2: mere remembrance alone
sandhi-split compound: smaraṇāt (abl.) + siddhiḥ (nom.) + vāñchita (desired) + iti (thus); L1/L2: accomplishment of what is desired by remembrance
locative plural compound: mata (doctrine/view) + ādiṣu (and others); L1/L2: in the doctrines and related contexts
sandhi: tat (that) + evam (thus); L1/L2: concluding transition, thus
compound: tanmayī-bhāva (becoming that/identity) + dāyinī (giving) + arcā-kriyā (worship act); L1/L2: worship rite that bestows absorption/identity
indeclinable causal conjunction; L1/L2: gives reason for the worship rite
